card.summary: The NDO Fairness Act of 2025 modifies the requirements and procedures for the government to obtain nondisclosure orders (NDOs) under the Stored Communications Act. These orders temporarily stop communication and remote computing service providers from telling customers or subscribers that the government has sought their records or electronic communications. The bill raises the legal standards required to get an NDO, limits the duration of NDOs, introduces mandatory court reviews, requires notice to targets when NDOs expire, and mandates annual reporting by the Department of Justice.
